The bubble exhibits strong iridescence with swirling patterns of cyan, magenta, yellow, and green on its upper hemisphere. It has a glossy, reflective surface that distorts the background and shows specular highlights. A small droplet or secondary bubble formation is visible attached to the right side.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a distinct, loop-like protrusion or droplet hanging off the right side of the sphere. While physically possible (a draining droplet), in AI generation this often represents a failure of the surface tension simulation, looking slightly like a melted handle rather than a natural fluid accumulation.

The reflection/refraction of the background in the lower left appears slightly smeared and lacks the crisp optical distortion expected from a perfect lens-like sphere, suggesting minor generative blur.
